hypotheses.statement: Combining same-day availability with diagnostic-fee transparency may improve qualified lead efficiency versus generic urgency.

observation.statement: The fixture variant recorded a lower qualified CPL than the fixture control during one simulated experiment.

learning.statement: For this fixture brand, pairing same-day availability with diagnostic-fee transparency is associated with lower qualified CPL than generic urgency creative.
learning.provenance: Derived from one sanitized simulated experiment and retained as a candidate rather than promoted automatically.
learning.applicability: Desert Ember HVAC fixture brand, Phoenix homeowner audience, same-day diagnostic offer, static fixture creative.
limitations: Simulated fixture evidence from one experiment is not causal proof.
The variant changed two message elements, so the responsible element is unresolved.
No live platform delivery, lead validation, or warehouse connector was used.

next_experiment.summary: Isolate fee transparency from availability while holding offer, audience, and format constant.
next_experiment.after: fee transparency isolated against matched control
